definitions.explanation: Flowers or leaves dried flat under weight, used for cards, framed art, and craft. Also the craft of making them — a popular hobby for children and a long-standing decorative art.

examples.japanese: {押|お}し{花|ばな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挟|はさ}んで→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧{押|お}し{花|ばな}にした。
examples.english: I pressed it between the pages of a book to make a pressed flower.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{押|お}し{花|ばな}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦しおり→しおり：09754_shiori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}していた→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother carefully kept the bookmark she had made from pressed flowers.

notes:
{押|お}し (pressing) + ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (flower); the second element voices to ばな in the compound. A classic summer-vacation craft project for elementary school children.
